title: CHAPTER 041 - Repair queue controller and launch 031-040
description: Full automated queue-controller repair chapter. READ/EVIDENCE prints the previous controller log and validates active v3.6, state 030 SUCCESS, PAT presence and all ten queued task files. BACKUP preserves controller/log/state. ONE LOGICAL CHANGE retires the old controller and installs a v2 controller that uses only GitHub Contents API for both queued-task reads and task.json writes. The controller waits until 041 is finalized, promotes 031, then promotes 032-040 only after each predecessor reaches a terminal state. Approval remains per chapter.
